explanation: Single ball falls under gravity with controller disabled (work=0). Inbound speed at floor contact ~18.3 m/s (steps 89-90, energy ~176 J conserved). After one floor contact step 91, vy is +28.96 m/s upward — larger than inbound despite e=0.5 (expected ~9 m/s) — so kinetic energy more than doubles to 427 J vs allowed ~198 J. Likely cause: floor impulse plus positional/Baumgarte correction adds spurious velocity proportional to impact speed/penetration, injecting energy on high-speed bounce. Counterfactual with same dt/steps but low impact speed shows no energy gain.
vision_note: The blue ball falls downward across steps 88-90 and reaches the floor in step 91. It is shown in contact with the floor at the violation step, matching the moment of high-speed impact before the spurious upward launch.
